name: hv16_dbk_cpl_s1

pin_regs.reason: Banks, controller and the collar leaf are hard children owning their registered endpoints (bank/controller pin flops, collar core pin flops); the parent holds only wires and the reset relay flops (ot_rst_relay on clk_rst). A parent pin flop would add a cycle to rr/wd/rq and the host bus.

slot_change_request: hb_dbk_<q> (d4f slot 560.0 x 400.0) -> 606.96 x 542.16 (1.12:1): 8 banks + controller + collar leaf on the 43.2 lattice cannot fit 560 x 400 (see make_dbk_cpl_parent.py); master ports: clk_tab[1:0] removed, clk_rst added (reset relay root, same die clock); rr/rq W, wd/wb/wa N, F20 host bus/status/straps E, clk_bank on the nearest face (W x3, N x3, S x1, E x1); OWNERS-HBM/STK 10-18: 606.96 x 542.16 (macro_edge 20 um), wd of bank rows 0-1 on the S face, rows 2-3 on N (wire_reach), F20 host bus over the full E face; HBM-DBKCPL 10-18: rr of the col2 banks (rr[514..769] bank 2 -> S face, rr[1799..2054] bank 7 -> N face, beside their wd; rr_valid stays W) for daemon bank_distance (157 um).
structural_change: L2H-HC 10-19 (H.STA.BLK.12): binds the CLOSED rt80 controller view (RR_RT 80 = d4g VM round trip budget; hv16_dbk_vp4_ctl_rt80-rt80-e135ae216 CLOSED TT +65.73/FF +20.29), same geometry as the HH-7 kit. Classified 65c2387ab (TT -12.30/FF +20.59/DRC 1): reg->reg u_control/bank_read_addr -> far bank L[5] ~457 um U-turn and bank_write_slot W-face star (macro->macro), L[4].wd -> wd port (macro->out), all wire reach between hard children; HH-7 per-face controller copies (3d37f28ac) cut the worst leg to ~343 um: gate 20261019-015514 macro->macro +3.6, macro->out +4.8, in->macro -135.5 pre-CTS (no hard-child insertion credit; routed in->reg was +45.4). Measured reasons (hv15_dbk_cp gate 1f18141cb, 10-16): clk_cp 1,844 sinks TT 421.6 / spread 126.5 (collar flops smeared between the 8 banks), rst_n port -> 793 loads unregistered incl. 8 bank macros + controller (in->macro -296.1), in->reg -170.8 u_cp.cmd[26] with the W face 98% pin-full; children off the 43.2 um lattice; 645.84 x 360.72 (1.79:1).  Why not the d4f slot 560 x 400: on the 43.2 um child lattice three 87.48-um bank rows need y = 43.2/172.8/302.4 (top 389.9, no N channel left in 400) and three 140.4-um columns need x up to 529.2, so 560 x 400 holds at most 2 x 3 = 6 banks; 8 banks + controller + collar leaf = 10 objects, and every bank must stay within ~480 um of BOTH the W face (rr) and the N face (wd) (textbook wire_reach 500 um/stage).  A 3-row ring (controller centre) cannot take the leaf within 1.5:1 (width >= 712 at height 432).  Chosen: 4 rows x 3 columns, 604.8 x 540 (1.12:1):   * col0 (x 86.4, 4 banks; 86.4 um W channel carries their 1,156 wd bits N), col1/col2 (x 259.2/432) banks in rows 0     and 3; the controller in col1 between rows 1-2 (bank star <= ~430 um), the collar leaf in col2 between rows 1-2     (W face -> controller E face 104 um; E face 21.6 um from the cluster E face where the F20 host bus enters);   * channels >= 32.4 um (columns) / 42.1 um (rows), every child on the 43.2 lattice;   * W face: rr per bank row (rq + rr_valid beside the controller row), <= 4.6 pins/um; N face: wd per bank column + wb/wa,     <= 4.5 pins/um; each clk_bank entry on the face point nearest its bank clock pin; clk_cp at the leaf clock pin.
